0.original: Erenville is relieved to see everything set to rights.

48.original: Hahaha! That was a pretty nice shot, right?

49.original: Now that we have the bracelet, let us return to Sheshenewezi Springs.

50.original: Will you be staying there long? I'd like to give you a proper thanks after I find my friends.

51.original: We weren't planning on it, but there's no need to rush. We'll see you at the Springs, then.

52.original: I'll catch up to you just as soon as I've taken care of my friends.

53.original: Welcome back. I'm glad to hear those bandits got what they deserved.

54.original: They were understandably worried, but I've told them of what happened in Hhusatahwi. Our minor adventure made for quite the tale.

56.original: My bracelet. Thank you. Thank you so much.

57.original: This is more than just a gift. It is a part of me I could never hope to replace.

58.original: Truly, Wuk Lamat is blessed to have such devoted friends.

59.original: Well, I wouldn't put it quite that way... I prefer to think of us more as long-standing acquaintances.

60.original: Regardless of how you choose to describe it, there's no denying the depth of your bond. Though I'm sure you'll continue to do so.

61.original: Can't say I'm surprised the deputy chief turned out to be the bandits' leader. I always knew something wasn't right about him.

62.original: An easy claim to make with the gift of hindsight.

63.original: (-Zekowa-)There you are. The <hex:021A020203>real<hex:021A020103> Daybreakers have arrived!

64.original: I'd like you to meet my two best friends, Kwikana and Liwine.

65.original: If it wasn't for you believing in Zekowa, and doing what you did, we'd still be locked up.

66.original: You have no idea how satisfying it was to see that bastard Wihuwte put behind bars.

67.original: We never gave up hope that Zekowa would find a way to get us out. He always was the best of the Daybreakers. Glad he was able to convince you to go along with his plan.

68.original: Unfortunately, our group is smaller now, and lacking in strength besides. Some outlaws might see us as an easy target.

69.original: Even so, if anyone should give the Dustwatch the slip, the Daybreakers'll be there!

70.original: We'll train night and day, so no one'll get the better of us ever again. Isn't that right?

71.original: Right! And you'll teach us how you draw your pistols so fast, won't you?

72.original: Well, we won't need to duel if all goes as it should.

73.original: But on the off chance it doesn't, we'd best make sure everyone can match or beat my speed.

74.original: We owe you a great debt, and one of these days, I'll be sure to repay it. On that you have my word.

76.original: If you'll excuse me, I shall find a quiet place to rest.

77.original: As I'll be here a while yet, though, do let me know if there is any way I can be of assistance.

78.original: Were you not planning to take the train home?

79.original: Oh, train service has been suspended. Didn't I tell you?

81.original: Something about the tracks being damaged in the last quake. The tunnel was closed as well.

82.original: An earthquake? It must have happened when we were still down south.

83.original: There've been quite a few tremors of late, and a rather large one struck not long before you two arrived. I can only hope no one was hurt...

84.original: At any rate, if you want to know when service will resume, you could speak with the stationmaster yourself.

85.original: Let's do that. The station is just over there.

86.original: I'd like to believe the train will be up and running again soon...

87.original: I'm sorry, but there's nothing we can do with the tracks as they are.

88.original: It seems people aren't too happy about the train delays.

89.original: We'll be ready to handle that timber when you and the chief get back.

90.original: With your help, we'll get the railroad operating again. And then you'll have the chance to see our engine in motion─it's poetry, I tell you!

91.original: Right, we've got work to be getting on with ourselves!

92.original: Though no small number live in Shaaloani, I must confess that I've never visited the home of the Hhetsarro.

93.original: As they largely live in accordance with older traditions, I suspect they may have a dim view of the railroads...
